CWE-20.name: Improper Input Validation
CWE-20.description: The product does not validate or incorrectly validates input that can affect the control flow or data flow of a program.

CWE-77.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
CWE-77.description: The product constructs a command using externally-influenced input, but does not neutralize special elements that could modify the intended command.

CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.description: The product constructs an OS command using externally-influenced input, allowing attackers to execute unexpected, dangerous commands.

CWE-79.name: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
CWE-79.description: The product does not neutralize user-controllable input before it is placed in output used as a web page served to other users.

CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.description: The product constructs SQL commands using externally-influenced input, allowing attackers to modify the intended SQL command.

CWE-119.name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
CWE-119.description: The product performs operations on a memory buffer, but can read from or write to a memory location outside the intended boundary.

CWE-125.name: Out-of-bounds Read
CWE-125.description: The product reads data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.

CWE-200.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
CWE-200.description: The product exposes sensitive information to an actor not explicitly authorized to have access.

CWE-269.name: Improper Privilege Management
CWE-269.description: The product does not properly assign, modify, track, or check privileges for an actor, creating an unintended sphere of control.

CWE-287.name: Improper Authentication
CWE-287.description: When an actor claims an identity, the product does not prove or insufficiently proves the claim is correct.

CWE-306.name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
CWE-306.description: The product does not perform authentication for functionality that requires a provable user identity.

CWE-352.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
CWE-352.description: The web application does not, or cannot, sufficiently verify a well-formed, valid, consistent request was intentionally provided by the user who submitted it.

CWE-400.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
CWE-400.description: The product does not properly control the allocation and maintenance of a limited resource, allowing an actor to influence the amount of resources consumed, leading to denial of service.

CWE-416.name: Use After Free
CWE-416.description: Referencing memory after it has been freed can cause a program to crash, use unexpected values, or execute code.

CWE-502.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
CWE-502.description: The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently verifying that the resulting data will be valid, allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

CWE-611.name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference (XXE)
CWE-611.description: The product processes an XML document that can contain XML entities with URIs resolving to documents outside the intended sphere of control.

CWE-798.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-798.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key, which it uses for authentication or internal data encryption.

CWE-862.name: Missing Authorization
CWE-862.description: The product does not perform an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action.

CWE-917.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement (Expression Language Injection)
CWE-917.description: The product constructs an expression language statement using externally-influenced input, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary EL statements.

CWE-284.name: Improper Access Control
CWE-284.description: The product does not restrict or incorrectly restricts access to a resource from an unauthorized actor.
